examples.english: Please report when you've completed the task.

notes:
タスク is a loanword from English "task." It is workplace and computing vocabulary rather than everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to complete a task
- タスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}り{振|ふ}る→割り振る：20081_warifuru⟧ - to assign tasks
- タスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to manage tasks
- タスク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧ - to get through tasks

COMPUTING:
In computing, タスク⟦マネージャー→マネージャー：29755_maneejaa⟧ (task manager) is a common application name.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ - work, job. The general everyday word; タスク is one discrete item within it.
- ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ - work, operation. Emphasizes the hands-on doing of it.
- ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧ - assignment, challenge. Used in school and for problems to be solved.
